products.name: AWS Security Hub & GuardDuty Enablement — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn on AWS threat detection and posture management — GuardDuty and Security Hub, org-wide, with one aggregated findings view.
products.description:
Turn on AWS threat detection and posture management — GuardDuty and Security Hub, org-wide, with one aggregated findings view.

Without GuardDuty and Security Hub, AWS threats and misconfigurations go unseen until they're an incident. This solution enables Amazon GuardDuty (threat detection) and AWS Security Hub (posture standards + findings aggregation) across the whole organization via a delegated admin, turns on the CIS/AWS FSBP standards, and builds a findings triage and response workflow.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Terraform, CLI & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • GuardDuty org-wide enablement with a delegated administrator
  • Security Hub with CIS AWS Foundations + AWS FSBP standards
  • Aggregated multi-account, multi-region findings view
  • Automated response (EventBridge → Lambda/SNS) for high-severity findings
  • Findings triage, suppression rules, and remediation runbook

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Continuous AWS threat detection and posture scoring with one aggregated, actioned findings queue — instead of silent, per-account blind spots.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 3 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AWSSEC-Discovery.sh — read-only baseline of GuardDuty + Security Hub state
    • AWSSEC-Report.sh — read-only findings + posture report from the aggregation
    • AWSSEC-Validate.sh — read-only validation that GuardDuty + Security Hub are

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
